title: Target Output Adapter Metadata
description: Metadata describing the output generated by a target adapter for a specific AI platform.

target.description: Target AI platform this output is adapted for

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this output was generated

generator_version.description: Version of the HarnessKit generator that produced this output

path.description: Relative path to the generated artifact within the target output directory

content_type.description: MIME type or logical content type of the artifact

size_bytes.description: Size of the artifact in bytes
